proposal.hypothesis: 256 threads per row (8 SIMD groups) with one half4 register load per thread reduces per-thread work from 32 strided elements to 4 vectorized elements, increasing occupancy and latency hiding while threadgroup reductions stay cheap.
One SIMDgroup per row holding 32 FP32 values per lane in registers eliminates threadgroup barriers and a second input pass for 256x1024 softmax, minimizing latency.
